description:
Where is everyone? Life360 answers that in one glance. Real-time location sharing and GPS tracking for the people who matter most — your family, your friends, your Circle. Less worrying, fewer "where r u?" texts.

Accurate location, honestly explained
Life360 updates location when it matters instead of running GPS constantly, which is how we keep battery use low. For the most reliable positions, keep Wi-Fi on — it improves accuracy significantly, especially indoors. If a location ever looks stale, opening the app refreshes it.

A family locator and phone tracker in one app
See where your kids, partner and parents are on a shared map. Get Place Alerts when someone arrives at or leaves home, school or work. Check Location History to see where the day went. Whether you call it location tracking, a location tracker, a tracking app, a GPS tracker or a phone locator, this is the one your whole family will actually keep installed.

Everyone opts in
Every member of a Circle joins on purpose and can see everyone else. No hidden tracking, no one watched without knowing. You choose who you share with, and you can stop any time.

Find your phone, and your stuff
Can Life360 find my phone? Yes — lost it down the sofa or left it at work, Life360 helps you find your phone fast. Life360's Tile trackers extend the same idea to pets and the things you lose most — keys, wallets, luggage, bikes.

Safety features included with membership
SOS Alerts: send a silent alert with your precise location to your Circle, emergency contacts and responders.
24/7 Emergency Dispatch: help on the way even when you can't make the call.
Crash Detection: we notice the crash and get help moving.
Identity Theft Protection: safeguard each family member's information, with a white-glove restoration service.
Roadside Assistance: towing, jumpstarts, tire changes, lockout help and refueling.
Flight Landing Notifications, Smart Notifications and private group chat.

Download Life360 for peace of mind, knowing your loved ones and valuables are secure. Join millions who trust Life360 for location sharing.

https://www.life360.com/privacy_policy/
https://www.life360.com/terms_of_use/

Explanation for App Permissions [Optional Permissions]
○ Camera: App accesses user's camera to allow users to take photos or videos on the app.
○ Location: App accesses location information to allow users to share location information to other Circle members.
○ Microphone: App accesses microphone to allow users to record and share voice memos.
○ Music and audio: App accesses music and audio to play music and audio.
○ Nearby devices: App accesses nearby devices to find, connect to and determine the relative position of nearby devices by using Bluetooth.
○ Notifications: App accesses notification to send notification to users.
○ Phone: App accesses user's phone to allow users to make phone calls on the app
○ Photos and videos: App accesses photos and videos to allow users to view photos and videos on the app.
○ Physical activity: App accesses physical activities to calculate and detect driving events, such as driving speed, use of breaks, and accident detection.

You may still use the app even if you withhold optional permissions. However, app features requiring permission may not be available in such case.
summary: Family locator & phone tracker: real-time GPS location sharing + SOS
title: Life360: Family Safety & GPS
